meta.description: Making multi-agent workflows visible and debuggable for designers and developers.

copy.tagline: 让多智能体工作流可视化并可调试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在构建多智能体系统并需要观察其内部行为
copy.tagline_en: Make multi-agent workflows visible and debuggable
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building multi-agent systems and need to observe their internal behavior

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你把多智能体工作流的内部运作展示出来：哪些智能体参与、顺序如何、决策过程、传递了什么信息、耗时多久、哪里出错，以及用户体验质量。
howto.when: 当你需要理解或调试多智能体工作流时触发，例如询问“这个工作流是怎么运行的？”或“哪里出了问题？”。

say.text: 展示这个工作流的智能体执行轨迹。
say.note: 会看到每个步骤的智能体顺序和结果。

say.text: 分析智能体之间传递的上下文有没有丢失。
say.note: 会显示传递详情和潜在问题。

say.text: 查看这个工作流的失败点和恢复方式。
say.note: 会列出失败步骤和用户体验影响。

howto.what_en: This skill makes multi-agent workflows visible and debuggable. Claude will show you which agents are involved, their order, decisions made, context transferred, timing, failures, and quality signals.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to understand or debug a multi-agent workflow, e.g., asking 'How does this workflow run?' or 'Where is the issue?'.

say_en.text: Show the execution trace of this workflow.
say_en.note: You'll see each agent step and result.

say_en.text: Analyze if any context was lost between agents.
say_en.note: Details of handoffs and potential issues.

say_en.text: List failures and how they were recovered.
